policyInventory.detail: Get-InsiderRiskPolicy cmdlet not present in current module set. Treat as unsupported automation surface. Do not map this to licensing. Collect Insider Risk policy evidence manually from the Purview portal.
manualEvidenceRequired: Purview portal export: Insider Risk Management > Policies (name, template, status, scope).
Purview portal export: Alerts reviewed/dispositioned for the current quarter.
Reviewer attestation linking alert dispositions to case records.

tenantEnablement.detail: Tenant enablement checks are informative only and do not prove Insider Risk policy coverage.
